payload.prompt: A single four-second 16:9 continuation from this exact supplied original Garten-Golum drawing. Keep its face, leaf ears, flower lamps and roots recognisable from first to last frame. Simultaneously, delicate roots beneath the Golem shift and intertwine with the paper texture, causing the flowers to bloom more vividly and the leaves to unfurl, enhancing the Golem's form and making its silhouette increasingly distinct and recognizable. Small painterly kinetic gestures only: blink, warm lamp shimmer, flower tilt and root ripple. Preserve exact colored-pencil/ink drawing, hand pressure, rough paper, flat composition and static camera. No text, letters, names, signs, replacement character, room, photorealism, 3D, glossy repaint, crop change, pan, zoom or cutaway.
